explanation: Expand around every character and every gap between characters. Track the longest palindrome and choose the earliest starting index when lengths tie.
timeComplexity: O(n squared) time for n characters.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space excluding the returned substring.
attribution: Original EPI Practice C# implementation, reusing and refining the repository-authored Blind75 algorithm fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
correctness: Every palindrome has either one center character or one center gap. Expanding each such center enumerates exactly its palindromic radii until the next pair mismatches. The stored longest candidate therefore covers every possible palindrome; the start-index comparison implements the earliest tie rule.
walkthrough: For "qlevelz", expand around the middle v. Equal e characters yield "eve", then equal l characters yield "level". The surrounding q and z differ, so expansion stops at length 5. Return "level".
edgeCases: Both odd and even centers must be examined.
When several longest palindromes tie, choose the earliest start.
